flavor.text: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.
It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
